claims: Online lottery allows users to purchase official Powerball, Mega Millions, and instant-win games via state-run websites/apps or legal courier services like Jackpocket.
Online lottery is available in over 25 U.S. states and D.C.
Users must be physically located in that jurisdiction to play.
Virginia, Pennsylvania, and North Carolina offer direct sales through their own websites or apps.
Jackpocket and Lotto.com buy official tickets on your behalf from licensed retailers.
Jackpocket and Lotto.com scan the official tickets.
Jackpocket and Lotto.com notify you of winnings.
Players must be physically located within the state or district where they are playing.
Physical location is verified by geolocation technology on your phone or computer.
Smaller prizes are typically credited directly to your online account.
Jackpot wins may require in-person collection.
At least 27 states have official online lottery options, including Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Michigan, New Hampshire, North Carolina, North Dakota, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and West Virginia.

Jackpocket operates in 19 jurisdictions, including Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Idaho, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, and Washington D.C.
VA Lottery offers "2nd Chance" opportunities to re-enter losing tickets.
The Jackpocket app was acquired by DraftKings in 2024.
The Jackpocket app operates in 14 states and Washington D.C.
